audience: recruiters and hiring managers who run open jobs and candidate pipelines in TalentLyft

useCases.title: See open jobs and their hiring stages
useCases.text: List the jobs, filtered by status or text. List the stages of one job, in order, to see its hiring steps.

useCases.title: Review candidates who applied to a job
useCases.text: List candidates, filtered by job or by creation date. Open one candidate, then one application, to read its stage, evaluation and answers.

useCases.title: Review interviews on the calendar
useCases.text: List calendar events for a date range, filtered by job, candidate or member. Use the member list to match each interviewer to their events.

useCases.title: Add a note to a candidate's timeline
useCases.text: Pick the team member who writes the note, then add it to the candidate's timeline. The team sees the note, and each call adds a new one.

useCases.title: Move an application to another stage
useCases.text: Read the job stages, then move one candidate application to a new stage. TalentLyft may send the usual stage notifications.
